name: KiCad + Arduino Development Environment
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y software-properties-common && sudo add-apt-repository -y ppa:kicad/kicad-10.0-releases && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y kicad kicad-libraries kicad-symbols kicad-footprints kicad-packages3d kicad-templates && sudo curl -fsSL -o /opt/arduino-ide.AppImage https://downloads.arduino.cc/arduino-ide/arduino-ide_2.3.10_Linux_64bit.AppImage && sudo chmod +x /opt/arduino-ide.AppImage && cd /opt && sudo /opt/arduino-ide.AppImage --appimage-extract && sudo mv /opt/squashfs-root /opt/arduino-ide && sudo ln -sf /opt/arduino-ide/arduino-ide /usr/local/bin/arduino-ide
